043package dev.visdb.seesaw.models;
044
045import java.sql.Array;
046import java.sql.JDBCType;
047import java.sql.ResultSetMetaData;
048import java.sql.SQLDataException;
049import java.sql.SQLException;
050import java.util.Arrays;
051import java.util.List;
052import java.util.Objects;
053
054import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
055import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils;
056
057import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
058
059/**
060 * Read and write a collection of data items from/to database.
061 * All items are the same jdbctype. How the items are stored is
062 * independent of this interface. There is no presumption that
063 * input/output data is copied; it should not be modified.
064 * <p>
065 * Some static methods useful for working with collections.
066 *
067 * @since 4.0.0
068 */
069// TODO: <K>
070public interface DbCollection {
071  /**
072   * @return the type of array elements handled by this model
073   */
074  JDBCType getJDBCType();
075
076  /**
077   * Get the data from the comp's RowSet.
078   *
079   * @param comp has RowSet and column
080   * @return an array, see {@link java.sql.Array#getArray() }
081   * @throws SQLException if a database related error occurs
082   */
083  Object readData(SsComponent comp) throws SQLException;
084
085  /**
086   * Put the data from a java object array to the RowSet.
087   *
088   * @param comp has RowSet and column
089   * @param data array of data to write to the database
090   * @throws SQLException if a database related error occurs
091   */
092  void writeData(SsComponent comp, Object data) throws SQLException;
093
094  /**
095   * Create an DbCollection for holding elements of the specified type for
096read/write of the component's table column.
097   *
098   * @param comp The component
099   * @param jdbcType element type of the collection
100   * @return A collection that works with the component
101   * @throws SQLException
102   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the component's column type is not
103   * suitable for saving a collection of the specified jdbcType.
104   */
105  public static DbCollection getSuitableDbCollection(SsComponent comp, JDBCType jdbcType)
106      throws SQLException {
107    DbCollection dbCollection;
108    JDBCType collectionType = jdbcType;
109    // there's also: DatabaseMetaData.getColumns() - TYPE_NAME is a column
110    ResultSetMetaData md = comp.getRowSet().getMetaData();
111    int columnTyp = md.getColumnType(comp.getColumnIndex());
112    JDBCType columnType = JDBCType.valueOf(columnTyp);
113    dbCollection = switch (columnType) {
114      case ARRAY -> {
115        // May not be any rows, so only use metadata to determine elemtype
116        JDBCType elemType = SsUtils.dbSupport().resolveArrayElementType(md, comp.getColumnIndex());
117
118        if (collectionType != elemType) {
119          String s = sf("collection type '%s' != ARRAY type '%s'", jdbcType, elemType);
120          throw new IllegalArgumentException(s);
121        }
122        yield new DbArray(elemType);
123      }
124      case CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR -> {
125        // TODO: have plugin specify default Delim
126        yield new DbStringCollection(collectionType, DbStringCollection.COMMA_SEP);
127      }
128      default -> {
129        String s = sf("Column type '%s' not handled for SSCollection.", columnType);
130        throw new IllegalArgumentException(s);
131      }
132    };
133    return dbCollection;
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * Converts a java array to list. Turns array of primitives into
138   * array of Objects.
139   *
140   * @param array a java array as described by {@link Array#getArray() }
141   * @return List with elements corresponding to input array's elements.
142   * @throws java.sql.SQLDataException
143   */
144  // TODO: put this into ConvertType
145  public static List<?> convertArrayToObjectList(Object array) throws SQLDataException {
146    Objects.requireNonNull(array);
147    if (!array.getClass().isArray())
148      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must be an array");
149    // logger.log(DEBUG, () -> "SSList.toObjArray() contents: " + array);
150
151    // TODO: Switch on type of array? dbArray.getClass().getComponentType()
152    //       java.lang.reflect.Array.get(Object array, int index)
153    int len = java.lang.reflect.Array.getLength(array);
154    try {
155      if (array.getClass().getComponentType().isPrimitive()) {
156        Object[] objects = new Object[len];
157        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) objects[i] = java.lang.reflect.Array.get(array, i);
158        return Arrays.asList(objects);
159      } else {
160        return (List<?>) Arrays.asList((Object[]) array);
161      }
162    } catch (final ClassCastException cce) {
163      // logger.log(ERROR, "Class Cast Exception.", cce);
164      throw new SQLDataException(cce);
165    }
166  }
167}
